subject: Allocation of July overage + VAT classification (invoice question)
messages:
From: Sophia Turner <sophia.turner@brightline.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brightline Finance <finance@brightline.io>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected July overage — allocation / VAT question

Hi Kimberly,

We just received invoice INV-2027-07-9887 and noticed a sizable overage line for July (token charges) that doesn't match our internal usage reconciliation. The total overage appears to be ~USD 18,400 and it's labelled as "ingest-burst-pricing" on your invoice. Our procurement team expects the July bill to be prorated across three sub-accounts under our org (dev / staging / prod) per our PO BR-4729, but the invoice shows the entire overage assigned to the top-level account.

A few asks:  
- Can you provide the raw usage export for 2027-07 with the session/request ids so we can map to our internal telemetry?
- If the overage is due to a burst (we suspect a backfill job), can Redwood apply the contractual proration across the three tagged sub-accounts?
- How should VAT be applied for this line? We're in the UK entity (Brightline Ltd) but our billing entity is the US head office — we need clarity for VAT reclaim and the invoice VAT field looks blank.

I've attached PO BR-4729 for reference. We need an answer by COB Monday to proceed with payment; otherwise finance will hold the entire invoice.

Thanks,

Sophia Turner
Head of Finance — Brightline
Sophia Turner
Brightline Ltd.
Attachment: Brightline_PO_BR-4729.pdf (application/pdf, 127KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Turner <sophia.turner@brightline.io>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected July overage — allocation / VAT question

Hi Sophia — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the PO. Sorry for the disruption. I'm looping in Rafael (account lead) and Connor (billing ops) and Grace from CS to investigate.

Quick answers while we pull data:  
- We'll export the July raw usage (session/request ids + tags) and share a CSV within 24 hours.
- If this is a replay/backfill from a staging job, we can discuss reassigning the tokens to the tagged sub-accounts and propose a prorated credit; that will need billing validation.
- VAT: Connor will validate tax treatment and confirm whether the invoice should show UK VAT or remain zero-rated given your entity mix.

Can you confirm the three sub-account IDs (dev/staging/prod) you want us to use for the proration mapping? If you prefer, we can propose a split based on our tag usage and send it for your sign-off.

I'll follow up with the export and a proposed allocation later today.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Turner <sophia.turner@brightline.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected July overage — allocation / VAT question

Hi Sophia — attaching the raw usage export for July and a short summary. See the CSV (redwood-usage-export-2027-07.csv) for per-request rows. Key notes:  

- We see a burst on 2027-07-18 from an ingest job with request IDs in the range r-7f3a* — that account used ~2.1M extra tokens.
- The burst originated from an API key tied to your top-level org, but 82% of the requests include a "sub_account" metadata tag. We can reattribute those tokens to the tagged sub-accounts.
- There is a small window (approx 45 minutes) where tags were missing; those rows will require manual mapping if you want them moved.

Proposal:  
1) Reassign rows that include sub_account tags automatically to dev/staging/prod as indicated (no change to total).
2) For untagged rows: propose proportionally splitting them across your three sub-accounts based on the tagged distribution for that day.
3) Apply a prorated credit for July overage back to the three sub-accounts and issue a corrected invoice (INV-2027-07-9887-R1).

On VAT: based on your billing entity we currently left VAT blank pending your confirmation of which legal entity is responsible for payment. If Brightline Ltd (UK) is the payer, we will need your VAT registration number to determine whether to apply reverse-charge VAT or zero-rate. Rafael — can you confirm the customer's legal payer?

Attachment: redwood-usage-export-2027-07.csv (text/csv, 2.3MB)

Connor O'Brien
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Sophia Turner <sophia.turner@brightline.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brightline Finance <finance@brightline.io>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 08:57:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Unexpected July overage — allocation / VAT question

Thanks, Connor — received the CSV and the preliminary plan looks reasonable. Confirming the sub-account IDs:
- dev: brightline-dev-12
- staging: brightline-staging-12
- prod: brightline-prod-12

The payer for this invoice will be Brightline Ltd (UK). VAT reg: GB999888777. We expect reverse charge treatment where applicable; please confirm the corrected invoice shows our VAT number and notes reverse charge.

Regarding the untagged window, we'd prefer you to assign those to prod unless the proportional split materially changes the result — assign to prod and flag for our review if it increases/decreases the proposed credit by more than 5%.

Also: because this is a mid-cycle correction we need the corrected invoice and a credit memo before we release the hold on payment. Please send the draft corrected invoice to finance@brightline.io.

Best,
Sophia

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Turner <sophia.turner@brightline.io>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected July overage — allocation / VAT question

Sophia — thanks for the quick confirmation and the VAT number. Action plan and timeline:  

1) Connor and team will reassign tagged rows now; untagged rows will be assigned to prod per your instruction. Connor will produce a proposed corrected invoice (INV-2027-07-9887-R1) and a credit memo by EOD Monday PST.
2) We'll include your VAT number on the corrected invoice and add the reverse-charge note in the VAT section. Rafael will review contractual proration language and confirm that the credit application to sub-accounts is within our standard billing policy (we expect yes).
3) Once the corrected invoice and credit memo are posted, finance@brightline.io can proceed with payment. If anything materially changes (>5%), we'll flag and route for your approval first.

Next steps: Connor to send the draft corrected invoice and the distribution table (dev/staging/prod token counts + credit amounts). Rafael to confirm contract/proration is fine. I'll set a 30-minute call Monday morning to walk through the numbers if you'd like.

Thanks again for the clear instructions — we'll get this sorted quickly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
